description: Shared Agentico plugin version v1 test vector. Single source of truth for the plugin release the app is built alongside: the Node plugin tests assert herdr-plugin.toml, package.json and package-lock.json carry `version`, and the Swift app tests assert AgenticoPluginCompatibility.bundled equals it. A plugin release bumps all of them together; the app then recommends updating Hosts whose plugin is older.
